benefits.mechanism: Allantoin is a keratolytic skin-conditioning agent that helps soften and slough away rough surface cells while improving skin feel.
benefits.what_it_means: Softens and smooths rough, dry skin and leaves it feeling comforted.

benefits.mechanism: It is a well-tolerated conditioning agent that improves surface comfort and smoothness.
benefits.what_it_means: Helps calm the feel of sensitive, reactive skin.

overview: Allantoin is a soothing, skin-conditioning agent that softens rough skin and comforts sensitive or reactive skin — a gentle supportive ingredient found across soothing formulas.
